_comment: Spec §4.3 on-device / authoring confidence weights. Policy: 'named OR officially recognized => keep (high); anonymous urban footways, private, abandoned, informal => drop (low)'. 'Officially recognized' is now GLOBAL: in_route_relation (member of an OSM hiking route relation) + network_national (iwn/nwn) give a country-agnostic 'real recognised trail' signal that needs NO per-country data source, alongside the optional per-country authoritative_match (DOC etc.). Tuned against the real NZ pilot: base is LOW (30) so an unknown trail is not trusted; a name OR route/network membership OR official backing is what lifts it. Loaded by the authoring build (dev-only) and mirrored by ScoringWeights.default in TrailScoring.swift; the two test suites pin these exact numbers.
